evidence.reason: The preview loop checks only that --output and its systemd/launchd children are outside the deploy root; it never verifies that each resolved child stays inside the resolved --output root. A symlink at --output/systemd or --output/launchd can point to live unit directories outside the checkout, pass the line 911 check, and then receive writes through render_units/render_plists at lines 922-923. This is an implementation error in the existing preview-write behavior, not a request to add new protection scope; resolving and containing each child is the smallest compatible fix.
